description_en: Queries the executor status and runtime configuration by using the ExecutorJobId returned by RunSemanticJob or ListSemanticJobRuns
description_zh: 使用 RunSemanticJob 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 返回的 ExecutorJobId 查询执行器状态与运行配置
name: GetSemanticJobDetail

parameters.help_en: The executor job ID. Use the Data.ExecutorJobId from the RunSemanticJob response or the ExecutorJobId from a ListSemanticJobRuns record
parameters.help_zh: 执行器任务标识，使用 RunSemanticJob 响应的 Data.ExecutorJobId 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 记录中的 ExecutorJobId
parameters.name: executor_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the job belongs. Use the ProjectId from the CreateSemanticJob response or a ListSemanticJobs list item
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属 DataWorks 工作空间 ID，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应或 ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 ProjectId
parameters.name: project_id

schema.description_en: The standard response for querying executor run details. Data contains the executor details currently returned for the specified ExecutorJobId
schema.description_zh: 查询执行器运行详情的标准响应。Data 是指定 ExecutorJobId 当前返回的执行器详情

Data.description_en: The job details returned by the executor. Used to determine the run status and view the actual runtime configuration
Data.description_zh: 执行器返回的任务详情，用于判断运行状态并查看实际生效的运行配置

AdvanceSettings.description_en: The advanced runtime settings returned by the executor
AdvanceSettings.description_zh: 执行器返回的高级运行设置

CodeParameters.description_en: The code parameter information returned by the executor. Used to troubleshoot the runtime configuration of this run
CodeParameters.description_zh: 执行器返回的代码参数信息，用于排查本次运行配置

CurrentSqlIndex.description_en: The index of the SQL fragment currently being processed by the executor
CurrentSqlIndex.description_zh: 执行器当前处理的 SQL 片段索引

CustomerName.description_en: The customer identifier of the executor job
CustomerName.description_zh: 执行器任务的客户标识

Datasource.description_en: The data source identifier used by the executor job
Datasource.description_zh: 执行器任务使用的数据源标识

Env.description_en: The runtime environment identifier returned by the executor
Env.description_zh: 执行器返回的运行环境标识

ExecTypes.description_en: The list of execution type codes returned by the executor
ExecTypes.description_zh: 执行器返回的执行类型编码列表

items.description_en: The list of execution type codes returned by the executor
items.description_zh: 执行器返回的执行类型编码列表

FileType.description_en: The node type code of the executor. Semantic jobs use Shell node code 6
FileType.description_zh: 执行器节点类型编码；语义任务使用 Shell 节点编码 6

ProjectId.description_en: The DataWorks workspace ID associated with the executor job
ProjectId.description_zh: 执行器任务关联的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group that actually executed the job
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 实际执行该任务的资源组标识

ResourceUrls.description_en: The list of resource URLs associated with the executor job
ResourceUrls.description_zh: 执行器任务关联的资源地址列表

items.description_en: The list of resource URLs returned by the executor
items.description_zh: 执行器返回的资源地址列表

Statuses.description_en: The list of status codes returned by the executor. Used to determine the current or final status of the job
Statuses.description_zh: 执行器返回的状态编码列表；用于判断任务当前或最终状态

items.description_en: The list of job status codes returned by the executor. A successful status includes 3
items.description_zh: 执行器返回的任务状态编码列表；成功状态包含 3

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
